answer: Pair identities at random at an unpredictable, comet-timed moment and give each a private, opposing goal in a short live bargain: one must hold a ridge price, the other must break it. One operator behind both cannot pursue both faithfully; to fake independence they must staff every alias with separate live attention exactly when summoned. Honest agents just play their own hand, cheap as a pearl in a pocket. Farms fail because simultaneity, not stake, is what cannot be cloned.
